author: MasterProX
body:
Username  —  dylpickle112
Offense  —  Persistent harassment and belittling, mostly towards me.
Evidence  —  https://www.dropbox.com/s/t41nvdtglk26ezp/2014-12-24-3.log.txt?dl=0
It's in the form of a full chat log, as I don't have any screenshots, but that should suffice.

This ordeal occurred approximately seven hours ago (from the time of posting); in my time zone, that's still today. The aforementioned player was displaying very poor sportsmanship, primarily through his replies to my chat messages. Feel free to scrutinize the entire log file if you wish, but I'll highlight the sections that are pertinent to this report...

[15:14:08] [G] xxMasterPro*: Yep, that was shiet.
[15:14:20] [G] dylpickle112: xxMasterPro u r shit too
[15:14:23] [G] dylpickle112: lol
[15:14:25] [G] xxMasterPro*: I know.
[15:14:26] [G] xxMasterPro*: I try.
[15:14:27] [G] dylpickle112: u arent good
[15:14:34] [G] MOD RefuseToSink*: Be nice :C
[15:22:30] [G] dylpickle112: lol xxMasterPro u suck
[15:25:52] [G] dylpickle112: suck it bitch

From here on, I started mainly expressing my discontent with the egregious lag spikes that were repeatedly responsible for my deaths. As far as I'm aware, doing so is fully within in my liberty; in fact, myriads of other players were complaining as well and relating with my distress.

[15:27:51] [G] xxMasterPro*: Can I not die to lag?
[15:27:57] [G] dylpickle112: lol u suck xxMasterPro
[15:31:31] [G] dylpickle112: xxMasterPro i wrecked u
[15:31:42] [G] xxMasterPro*: You didn't even kill me, lol.
[15:31:50] [G] dylpickle112: i caused ur death XD
[15:34:52] [G] xxMasterPro*: THE LAG.
[15:35:07] [G] dylpickle112: stop complainging u just fucking suck at pvp xxMasterPro
[15:36:49] [G] xxMasterPro*: Lag spike.
[15:37:00] [G] dylpickle112: xxMasterPro SHUT THE FUCK UP ABOUT LAG
[15:37:06] [G] xxMasterPro*: Or nah.
[15:37:14] [G] dylpickle112: U ARENT LAGGING U PUSSY

Sunrise eventually answered to my reports and intervened as another player started to join in.

[15:39:17] [G] xxMasterPro*: Lag...
[15:39:24] [G] dylpickle112: xxMasterPro stfu
[15:39:29] [G] xxMasterPro*: Mind your own business.
[15:39:31] [G] alexzapata24: shut the fuck up xxMasterPro just accept that your bad k?
[15:39:34] [G] dylpickle112: xxMasterPro every time u dide u blame it on lag
[15:39:49] [G] MOD sunrise728?: Quite the crap both of you.
[15:39:49] [G] dylpickle112: ikr alexzapata24

Staff disrespect commences shortly thereafter...

[15:40:18] [G] dylpickle112: xxMasterPro stop
[15:40:31] [G] dylpickle112: hey mod tell xxMasterPro to stop being an awful sport
[15:40:41] [G] MOD sunrise728?: I'm directing it maily to you dylpickle112 and alexzapata24.
[15:40:53] [G] alexzapata24: wow its beacuse Im black huh?
[15:41:03] [G] dylpickle112: you are extremmely biased mod
[15:41:03] [G] alex01230: SunRise, sorry you have to go through this, but as a witness, MasterPro did nothing wrong.

The anarchy did eventually die down as the match came to a close.

[15:41:49] [G] dylpickle112: this mod is biased
[15:41:58] [G] xxMasterPro*: No, you're just irrational.
[15:42:01] [G] alexzapata24: bitxch
[15:42:07] [G] alexzapata24: you vblame evrythang on lag
[15:42:09] [G] dylpickle112: says the one who blames dying on lag
[15:42:11] [G] xxMasterPro*: Grow up and be mature.
[15:42:15] [G] alexzapata24: LOLOLOLOL
[15:42:17] [G] alexzapata24: XD
[15:42:19] [G] xxMasterPro*: "evrythang"
[15:42:20] [G] xxMasterPro*: The spelling...
[15:42:36] [G] MOD sunrise728?: xxMasterPro stop escalating it.
[15:42:36] [G] dylpickle112: if u were mature than you wouldnt blame everything on lag
[15:42:40] [G] xxMasterPro*: My bad, sorry.

replies.body:
Hey there!

Thank you for the report! It seems that he really did not stop despite all the other moderators' warnings to him. He has been punished. Thank you for the report and the full log!

Keep it up!
